svg.font-family: Geist, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
svg.title: The life of a request
svg.desc: One request through ORION, in seven stages along a line. 1: it is heard (his name, or a HUD's talk button), typed in a HUD with pictures, or sent on Discord, where a voice note is transcribed by Whisper. 2: the TurnRunner runs one turn at a time and answers a summons without the model. 3: the brain prepares: it embeds the request once, matches a skill, recalls up to three memories, writes the turn's tail and picks the toolbox. 4: the model's rounds: it streams text and speech starts at the first comma; tool calls end a round; read-only tools run in parallel. 5: the hub, for every call: can this machine run it; is it risky after web or app content, in which case you are asked in the HUD, aloud or on Discord, and no answer means no; then it runs, its text and pictures come back sized down, and the turn is tainted if the tool read the open world. 6: the results go back to the model for another round until it answers. 7: the reply is spoken on this machine or in the browser carrying the voice, shown in every HUD and sent back to Discord; the history keeps a note in place of pictures, and the memory review comes later.
